tools.event_sequence_and_checks: Validate identity/OBO→A0 current actor→A1 `GET /api/users/me/sites` without pinned-only filtering→check course flag/membership and effective visit eligibility→map `siteId,title`, discard unrelated rich fields, sort/cap honestly→return. B0 supplies placement discovery only if later workflows need it; no browser form is needed for this tool. Source IDs and existing membership semantics are retained. Test unpublished/deleted/public-only sites, multiple page tools, empty lists and oversized responses. Do not open every course's tool page merely to list courses.

Validate actor/course→determine the native role/access without calling a known broad grader aggregate route→B0/B1 Gradebook→B6 current-user StudentPage→read released visible rows and maximums→establish native item IDs using a safe unambiguous metadata/own-API correlation→sort/normalize blank versus zero, points versus percentages, locale and IDs→return only the current user's grades. A2 is a student-only shortcut when its field coverage suffices; it is not a grader-own-score source. For mixed-role users test the StudentPage current-user binding and metadata permissions. Source-confirmed own-page behavior improves coverage; exact ID/precision/empty-setting semantics still require fixture proof. No arbitrary student target, title-derived ID or aggregate-to-own conversion.

Validate course→A3 narrow read where coverage is proven, otherwise B0/B1 Announcements→B2 native list/detail pagination→apply the public visibility/main-channel rules and read authoritative native IDs→normalize title/plain body/author/date→bind local cursor to actor/query/observation→return. Stop on native completeness evidence and configured budgets; do not silently keep the browser's page-size default. For an instructor, distinguish permission to see drafts from the public tool's intended published-visible output. Test older announcements beyond A3's date window, merged channels, scheduled/retracted/group/role visibility and page changes.

Validate course/Assignment relation and grade scope→B0/B1 Assignments→B7 native grade-assignment list (or verified A5)→collect submitted rows and exact submission/submitter references across native pages→prove all-submitters scope before retrieving evidence where the public contract requires it→filter submitted-only metadata, preserve original cap and sort/null-date policy→return cursor page. Test student/outsider denial, grade-only TA, group submissions spanning allowed/unallowed users, anonymous mode and changed pagination. Unknown object equality/scope is not repaired after fetching forbidden bodies.
